annotation.boundary_notice: Manually reviewed approximate boundary. The washer housing and door were checked from multiple views; small contact-edge, stand and bottle-base blur remains. Removing it cannot reconstruct the occluded background.

provenance.membership: Visually inspected washer shell volume plus protruding door; visible neighbouring cardboard excluded. Volume resolved to explicit original source rows, without changing canonical ownership.
provenance.review: Six orthographic source-point views, native splat isolation from front/back and room removal/restoration from front/side. No independent segmentation accuracy measurement.
